name: whizzbang
desc:
hush, here comes a whizzbang
now you soldiers get down on the stairs
down in your dugouts and say your prayers

hush, here comes a whizzbang
and it's making straight for you
and you'll see all the wonders of none man's lan'
if a whizzbang hits you





console controls (PS/Xbox):
Square/X = load weapon
Triangle/Y = hammer/shoulder weapon
Circle/B = ready/aim weapon
L2 = use scope (sharpshooter class only)
DPadLeft = call for medic
DPadDown = callouts
